scope_guards: Article 4 direction areas alter specified permitted-development rights and do not amount to a general development prohibition.
The conservation-area dataset is incomplete and contains duplicates; absence and raw counts are not clearance evidence.
Conservation-area designation is a planning consideration and not an automatic refusal or title restriction.
Tree-preservation orders and tree-preservation zones are related but distinct dataset concepts and are not summed.
Partial provider coverage means a missing tree record is not evidence that no TPO exists.
Dataset geometry does not establish an HMLR title, ownership or exact development red-line.
API and dataset freshness do not prove an executed candidate-specific intersection or current legal search.
No score or promotion is written without exact current constraint, planning, title and site evidence.
